arStrings.szText:
{c_label}Cooldown:{/c_label} {c_resource}{Cooldown Time}{/c_resource} seconds
{if:ADVANCED_TOOLTIP}{c_label}Lucky Hit Chance: {/c}{c_resource}{Combat Effect Chance}%{/c}
{/if}Create a destructive ritual for {c_number}{SF_4}{/c} seconds that grants you {c_important}{u}Volatility{/u}{/c} while within.

Killing enemies or Demons within fuels the ritual's chaotic hellfire, increasing the chance for each enemy to explode for {c_number}{payload:IMPACT}{/c} damage on death.
While you are within {c_important}Sigil of Chaos{/c}, you and your {c_important}Summons{/c} deal {c_number}{payload:HELLISH_REBUKE_IMPACT}{/c} damage to enemies when attacked.

{c_important}Sigil of Chaos{/c} is now cast around yourself for {c_number}{SF_17}{/c} seconds and instantly explodes your {c_important}Lesser Demons{/c} within for {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_B_ IMPACT_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage. Cooldown increased to {c_number}{SF_19}{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Sigil of Chaos{/c} becomes an {c_important}Abyss{/c} Skill and kills within now send out {c_number}{SF_21}{/c} tendrils of abyssal smoke that deal {c_number}{payload:SMOKE_IMPACT}{/c} damage and pierce through {c_important}{u}Hexed{/u}{/c} enemies.
{c_important}{u}Volatility{/u}{/c} from {c_important}Sigil of Chaos{/c} now lasts for {c_number}{SF_24}{/c} seconds after you leave the area.
Sacrifice {c_number}[{SF_27}*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life to instantly trigger each of {c_important}Sigil of Chaos'{/c} kill costs, up to {c_number}[{SF_27}*{SF_10}*100|%|]{/c} total.
{c_important}{u}Volatility{/u}{/c} empowered casts within {c_important}Sigil of Chaos{/c} count as triggering {c_number}{SF_28}{/c} kills.
Hitting an enemy with {c_important}Sigil of Chaos{/c} has a {c_number}[{SF_30}*100|%|]{/c} chance to trigger the effect on them again.
